intro: Bold in form and quietly thoughtful in function, Upmods Marcel brings together tall comfort, subtle storage, and soft light. It is designed to elevate both your room and your routine.

features.title: A headboard that supports and elevates
features.text: Our tall, rectangular headboard is cushioned for your comfort—giving you the right height to lean back and relax with ease.

features.title: Storage that stays out of sight
features.text: The lift-up box storage lets you tuck away linens, pillows, and extras—so your room stays neat, without effort. Available in multiple storage options, so you can choose what works best for your home and lifestyle.

features.title: A finish that’s quietly confident
features.text: We chose a matte engineered wood surface to give your space a refined, understated look that never feels loud.

features.title: Headboard space that works for you
features.text: With integrated storage in the headboard, you’ll always have room for bedtime reads, remotes, and your nighttime essentials.

features.title: Side tables with light built in
features.text: Our built-in side tables come with soft LED lighting—giving you gentle glow and practical space right where you need it.

features.title: A ledge that makes room for what matters
features.text: We added a thoughtfully placed display ledge so you can keep your nighttime reads, candles, or keepsakes right where you want them—close, visible, and beautifully arranged.

name: Upmods Marcel King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
